questions.stem: Which of the following best describes commercial agriculture?

options.text: Farming aimed at producing goods for sale in the market
Farming that relies solely on traditional methods
Farming that does not require any external inputs

questions.stem: Which of the following best explains the term 'agricultural productivity'?
